system.description:
Beginning at 14th level, your ability to call upon your Void Soul has reached a new level of control and prowess. When casting a jutsu while your Void Soul is not summoned, you may temporarily call upon it by spending superiority die. When you do, your Void Soul momentarily comes forth and casts the jutsu with you, which causes the jutsu to lose the Hand Sign (HS) and Chakra Molding (CM) components until the completing of this casting and the first attack roll you make is at Advantage or the first saving throw to resist is made at disadvantage.

Alternatively, if you are benefiting from Superego Manifestation when you use this feature, you have no need to call on another you, as you are all you need. You gain the previous benefit allotted by this feature, in addition If a maneuver you use would inflict a condition, it instead inflicts 2 ranks of that condition, if able.
